verdict.rationale: Vanta documents official, type-safe SDKs generated from its OpenAPI specification, including one for Node.js, Deno, Bun and the browser. However, the docs scope them explicitly to the Auditor API, so building against the main Manage Vanta API (controls, documents, tests, custom resources) through an official SDK is not evidenced. missing for 10: SDK coverage of the Manage Vanta API, documentation of the full set of SDK languages beyond TypeScript/JS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
